{{Short description|Israeli-American cosmologist}}
'''Yoel Rephaeli''' ([[Hebrew language|Hebrew]]: יואל רפאלי) is an Israeli-American [[cosmologist]]. He is a Professor of Physics at [[Tel Aviv University]], Israel.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www2.tau.ac.il/Person/exact/physics/researcher.asp?id%3Daiemhidji |title=School of Physics and Astronomy - Yoel Rephaeli |access-date=December 29, 2011 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120205065326/http://www2.tau.ac.il/Person/exact/physics/researcher.asp?id=aiemhidji |archive-date=February 5, 2012 }}</ref> Rephaeli studies the [[Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect]] [https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Sunyaev+Zeldovich%22&ie=UTF-8&oe=UTF-8&hl=en]{{dead link|date=July 2016 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }} and the astrophysics of [[galaxy cluster]]s.
